167.title: Consolidate Solana client and recovery with native validator qualification
167.body:
## Why

The Solana core work was spread across overlapping branches, with incompatible reader/planner additions and several asynchronous recovery hazards. This combines the retained behavior and gives the composed client an actual validator CI gate.

## Changes

- Fully integrate #151, #152, #153, #157 and #158; preserve their source heads as parents.
- Keep bounded reader cancellation, same-slot payout inspection, deployment identity, branded snapshots, off-chain consent/replay, exact wallet messages, durable send-marker semantics, and recovery.
- Repair physical dispatch after disposal, wrong-genesis terminal reconciliation/height-floor poisoning, registry-valid recovery IDs, and full-binding recovery displays.
- Apply freeze-authority permits before funding while retaining valid funded release/refund/payout exits; actual frozen custody remains blocked.
- Add real-validator composed-client acceptance to the pinned Solana workflow, including the real 1800-second refund wait. No skip flag is enabled.

Depends on #166. This PR is stacked on its branch to keep the review scoped; retarget to main after #166 merges.

## Verification

Published tree `3525b25f7c9a0abb7b8ab7ecae6a880730cda13b` exactly matches local `54f8eedc7adecfdf3e99e90df40343dcdbf94e22`. Combined executable source at `ffc483048f59ac5aef4826c534898d89bc5e4049` passed **1,876/1,876** tests, zero skipped, plus typecheck, specifications, import boundaries, 50 build-policy tests, default and demo builds. The subsequent commit only adds the independent review report and bounded evidence logs.

The isolated Solana candidate passed 250 client tests, 48 native program tests, SBF build, formatting, Clippy, JavaScript/Python vectors, and IDL comparison. The final recovery-display regression and focused 20-case independent suite passed. Exact source scopes and red/green evidence are committed.

Local real-validator startup is blocked by host io_uring/Unix-socket restrictions. **The hosted validator gate must pass before merge**; LiteSVM results do not substitute for it. Browser Solana wallet/exchange integration and the real encrypted-vault journal adapter are separate follow-ups. No browser trading, public-testnet or release qualification is claimed.

See [Solana qualification](https://github.com/djshellshoxxx/p2p-offramp/blob/integration/solana-core-qualification-20261118/packages/chain-solana/docs/integration-qualification-20261118.md) and [independent core review](https://github.com/djshellshoxxx/p2p-offramp/blob/integration/solana-core-qualification-20261118/docs/execution/INDEPENDENT-CORE-REVIEW-2026-11-18.md). `ReleaseEnabled=0`; no public deployment or real-funds activity.
